# Embra

> Infrastructure for frontend, Node.js / Next.js and PostgreSQL projects. Accepting project enquiries with direct setup support and pricing on request.

## Getting started
Contact hello@embra.cloud or https://zalo.me/0329589421 with the project's stack, existing hosting and requirements. Configuration, integrations, production suitability, support, data location and pricing are confirmed individually before deployment. Do not infer SLA, uptime, lossless restore, free tiers or self-service signup.

The migration review example is illustrative, not customer telemetry. Additional services are not included by default. The static website does not submit forms or provision resources. No public CLI/API endpoint is advertised.
